newsitem.title: UK: UK's FTSE ends below 4,600, hit by Budget concerns.
newsitem.headline: UK's FTSE ends below 4,600, hit by Budget concerns.

text.p: London's FTSE 100 share index ended a week of constant retreat with another heavy fall on Friday, tumbling below the 4,600 level in late trade as index futures dived and dragged down the cash market.

Dealers said continued concerns about the outlook for British interest rates and the contents of the new Labour government's July 2 Budget were casting a cloud over the FTSE and had sparked a late sell-off in futures.
The blue-chip index ended 59.8 points lower at 4,593.9, its fifth successive fall. It has dropped 190 points, or four percent, since reaching a record closing high last Friday.
